newsitem.title: USA: AT&T confirms fixed wireless technology.
newsitem.headline: AT&T confirms fixed wireless technology.

text.p: AT&T Corp, looking for additional methods to reach local telephone customers without relying on the regional Bells, on Tuesday confirmed that it had developed a wireless technology to provide that link.
The technology is similar though faster to that being developed by a number of other companies, and will be beta-tested by AT&T in Chicago later this year.

"I'm not sure people are grasping how new this is," said Nick Kauser, AT&T's lead developer on the project. "You can use it for a clear Internet connection," he told Reuters. He added that it was 16 times faster than other such systems.
